feat(camellia): migrate universal material library pages (#37)

## Summary
- migrate `camellia` universal material library entry pages for `font`, `icon`, `border`, `element`, and `seal`
- add a shared parameterized `universal/:domain` route family covering list, item detail, group management, and hidden manage pages
- reuse shared upload, preview, delete-confirm, and form shells while wiring sidebar entries through permission-aware navigation metadata

## Validation
- `pnpm --dir bougainvillea install --frozen-lockfile`
- `pnpm --dir bougainvillea typecheck:camellia`
- `pnpm --dir bougainvillea build:camellia`
- local `react-router-serve` smoke for `/universal/font`, `/universal/icon`, `/universal/border`, `/universal/element`, `/universal/seal`, `/universal/icon/group`, `/universal/icon/item/icon-cart-outline`, `/universal/border/group/border-festival`, `/universal/element/manage`, `/universal/seal/manage`, `/universal/seal/group/seal-opener`

## Manual QA
- open each migrated material page from the camellia sidebar and verify the shared list shell renders
- confirm hidden `group`, `item`, and `manage` routes load from direct links for grouped material domains
- exercise upload, preview, delete-confirm, and form-mode UI from the new shells
